kernel.value: K_B: W_ij = w0 + w_exc * cos((theta_i - theta_j)/2)^(2k) = w0 + w_exc * ((1+cos(d_circ))/2)^k
kernel.rationale: R26-03 §5: minimal S1-valid repair of the NA-1 kernel; smooth class only
unresolved: k in {2,4,8} to be selected per NE-6 gain sweep before freeze

distance_function.value: d_circ = wrap(theta_i - theta_j) in (-pi, pi] via atan2(sin x, cos x); seam fixture mandatory

kernel_baseline_arm.value: K_A von Mises e^(kappa*(cos d - 1)), kappa > 0, as D-4 comparison baseline (identical to chord-Gaussian)

inhibition_arms.value: BOTH frozen as separate arms: MODEL_MAX (g_inhib * max_j r_j, NA-1 source-exact) and MODEL_SUM (g_inhib * sum_k r_k, R25-03 source-exact); equivalence NOT claimed; NF-05 outcomes variant-specific

w0.note: declare per arm after NE-6 sweep; w0 < 0 admissible as subtractive baseline (lateral-inhibition profile)

w_exc.note: per arm; scale with kernel mass 2*sqrt(pi/k)

p.value: replaced by k = p/2; bare non-admissible p REJECTED

timestep_dt.value: fixed dt = 0.05 s suggested; must give >= 600 steps for T_out = 30 s cell

activation.value: tanh cap primary arm (differentiability); max(0, h) secondary arm; both documented

noise.value: independent Gaussian xi_i ~ N(0, sigma^2), sigma declared per arm; external witness uncertainty declared separately

seeds.value: counter-based (splitmix64 on cell id + run index); deterministic replay mandatory

convergence.value: bump convergence: max |r(t+1) - r(t)| < 1e-9 over 100 consecutive steps AND exactly one peak present

placement.value: symmetric around theta_inject at separation pi

relaxation_time.value: fixed 1000 update steps after injection, plus snapshot grid {100, 300, 1000}
relaxation_time.note: NA-1 gives no numeric relaxation time; this proposal makes it deterministic

peak_counting_rule.local_maxima: r_i > r_(i-1) AND r_i > r_(i+1), circular

prominence.value: peak prominence >= 0.10 * global max, measured relative to the higher adjacent valley

plateau_tie.value: plateau of length <= min_separation counts as ONE peak (centroid); longer plateaus reject as ambiguous

null_activity_guard.value: if total activity < 1e-6 * N or no local maximum passes prominence: classify ZERO_VALID_BUMP, which is a FAILURE, not a collapse

pva_guard.value: PVA undefined-vector guard: |sum r e^(i theta)| < 1e-9 -> UNDEFINED_READOUT failure

nf05.arms: MODEL_MAX and MODEL_SUM both; outcome reported per arm

d0_definition.value: d_circ(theta_hat(t0+dt), theta_hat(t0)), I_ext = 0, after full convergence

d3_120s.note: calibration proposal, not biological fact (source-exact text)

non_120s_bounds.value: NO source-exact bound. NEW_PROPOSAL hypothesis to be TESTED (not assumed): sqrt(t/120 s) scaling of the 120-s bound; report as UNTHRESHOLDED_OBSERVATION until separately adjudicated

bound_traj.value: per-trajectory bound = 3 bins (aligned with p99), equal-bound => STALE (closed comparison: >= bound triggers)

quantile_estimator.value: order statistics with binomial CI (Clopper-Pearson) on exceedance counts; p99 from 100 seeds reported with CI and flagged wide

detector_vs_measurement.value: NE-8 detector-logic runs strictly separate from D-0/D-3 measurement runs; MUST_NOT_MIX (source-exact)

multiple_comparisons.value: per-cell decisions independent; no aggregate reject rule across T_out (source-exact R2 rule preserved)
